rationale: I re-hashed the held texts (EO_10946.txt 380a6151..., EO_11374.txt 124f998e...) and confirmed ACT:EO:10946>EO:11374 span 2255-2318 exactly: 'Executive Order No. 10946 of May 26, 1961, is hereby revoked.' Identity of the original (26 FR 4629, signed 1961-05-26, title 'Establishing a program for resolving labor disputes at missile and space sites') agrees with API:cc045a3cc44ba1b1043839a9. I read the original in full: secs. 1-8 establish and run the Missile Sites Labor Commission, committees, panels and procedures; sec. 9 makes an emergency-fund finding with FY1961-62 payment authority and compensation. I read EO 11374 in full (32 FR 14199, signed 1967-10-11, published 1967-10-13). Sec. 1 abolishes the Commission and transfers its functions to FMCS. Secs. 2-5 provide for continued priority procedures, agency cooperation, transfer of records and property, and pending disputes. Sec. 6 is an unqualified whole-order revocation with no savings or delayed-effect wording. The cruden number search (4 hits) shows only EO 11374 copies and the original: no contrary or earlier whole end, and no revival. The history has no flags. One minor imprecision: the producer says no command has an own-terms end, but sec. 9's FY1961-62 payment authority was fiscal-year limited. The producer keeps that as a lifecycle gap, and it does not affect the whole-order NO. Remaining lifecycle gaps: the first-effective date (signing is not asserted as effective), residual effects of the sec. 4-5 transfers and pending disputes, the absence of a complete later-source search, and page-image confirmation. This is a nonauthoritative provisional NO proposal only; no certification.
